Biomarker Delta Analysis & Precision Intervention Report

Testing Timeline

  • Test 1: Order ORD-017 | Beta Test (150 biomarkers) | Sample Date: June 21, 2026, 8: 45 p.m. (Report Date: July 15, 2026)
  • Test 2: Order ORD-001 | Beta Test (150 biomarkers) | Sample Date: June 21, 2026, 8: 45 p.m. (Report Date: May 28, 2026)
  • Test 3: Order ORD-006 | Beta Test (150 biomarkers) | Sample Date: July 9, 2026, 6: 00 p.m. (Report Date: May 28, 2026)

Longitudinal Biomarker Delta Analysis

Biomarker / Formula Test 1 Test 2 Test 3 Trajectory (Δ) Physiological & Nutritional Significance
Lactate
C3H6O3 (m/z 89.02)		 257 1, 151, 671 437, 013 Spike at Test 2 → Clearing at Test 3 Indicates an acute anaerobic glycolytic response or exertion event during Test 2, followed by significant metabolic clearance by Test 3 as aerobic oxidation efficiency improved.
Alanine
C3H7NO2 (m/z 88.04)		 22, 673 3, 784 27, 287 Rebound / Increase Reflects active glucose-alanine cycle activity and amino acid turnover, signaling increased gluconeogenic supply and muscle tissue recovery engagement.
Valine / Betaine
C5H11NO2 (m/z 116.07)		 27, 940 8, 466 77, 295 Sharp Elevation Expanded pool of essential branched-chain amino acids (BCAAs) available for skeletal muscle repair and energy homeostasis post-exercise.
Suberic Acid
C8H14O5 (m/z 189.07)		 0 33, 529 3, 333 Marked Reduction Dicarboxylic acid marker associated with peroxisomal ω-oxidation during mitochondrial stress. Its ~90% reduction by Test 3 demonstrates recovery of primary mitochondrial β-oxidation.
Ascorbate
C6H8O6 (m/z 175.02)		 30, 346 2, 333 9, 423 Rebuilding Pool Reflects systemic antioxidant status. Depleted during high physiological stress (Test 2) and actively rebuilding to neutralize reactive oxygen species (ROS).
Taurine
C2H7NO3S (m/z 124.01)		 35, 667 1, 655 21, 318 Rebound Serves key functions in osmoregulation, cytoprotection, and skeletal muscle recovery capacity. The rebound indicates enhanced tissue stabilization.

Insights Grounded in Metabolomics Research

Based on current clinical literature and nutritional metabolomics frameworks (e.g., Guasch-Ferré et al., 2018; LeVatte et al., 2022):

  • Dynamic Exposure vs. Habitual Baseline: Metabolomic profiles in biofluids serve as real-time readouts of endogenous metabolic adaptation and short-term dietary inputs. The acute shifts observed in Test 2 highlight transient metabolic stressors, whereas Test 3 demonstrates returning homeostasis.
  • Mitochondrial Adaptation & Fatty Acid Pathways: The substantial decline in dicarboxylic intermediates (suberic acid) alongside lactate reduction signifies a transition toward efficient aerobic respiration and balanced mitochondrial energy utilization.
  • Amino Acid Pools & Muscle Recovery: Upregulation of circulating BCAA pools (valine) and gluconeogenic precursors (alanine) highlights active tissue repair and protein turnover, necessitating sufficient dietary protein and micronutrient support.

Precision Diet Plan

Day Breakfast Lunch Dinner Snacks & Hydration
Monday 3 scrambled eggs, 1/2 cup oats with blueberries, 1 tbsp chia seeds Grilled chicken breast (6 oz), 1 cup quinoa, mixed greens with olive oil Baked salmon (6 oz), roasted sweet potato, steamed broccoli Whey protein shake with banana; 3L water with lemon
Tuesday Greek yogurt (1 cup) with crushed walnuts, strawberries, and flaxseed Turkey wrap in whole-wheat tortilla, avocado, spinach, sliced tomatoes Pan-seared tofu or sirloin steak (6 oz), wild rice, asparagus Apple slices with almond butter; 3L water
Wednesday Omelet with spinach, mushrooms, feta; 1 slice whole-grain sourdough Salmon bowl with brown rice, edamame, cucumber, sesame-ginger dressing Grilled chicken breast (6 oz), roasted squash, steamed green beans Orange or citrus fruits (Vitamin C / Ascorbate boost); 3L water
Thursday Overnight oats with protein powder, chia seeds, raspberries Lean beef patty (6 oz) over arugula, quinoa, roasted beetroot Baked cod or halibut (6 oz), baked potato with skin, sautéed kale Handful of raw almonds & pumpkin seeds; 3L water
Friday 3 poached eggs, 1/2 avocado, 1 slice whole-grain toast Grilled chicken Caesar salad (light olive oil dressing), whole-wheat roll Baked turkey meatballs, zucchini noodles, marinara sauce, side salad Cottage cheese with fresh pineapple; 3L water
Saturday Smoothie: protein powder, spinach, frozen berries, almond milk, peanut butter Tuna salad over mixed greens, cherry tomatoes, cucumbers, olive oil Grilled steak or tempeh (6 oz), sweet potato wedges, grilled zucchini Dark chocolate (85%) & walnuts; 3L water
Sunday Whole-grain pancakes topped with berries and Greek yogurt Roasted chicken breast (6 oz), farro grain bowl, roasted root vegetables Baked salmon (6 oz), quinoa, steamed cauliflower and carrots Chamomile tea, fresh berries; 3L water

Precision Exercise & Physical Activity Plan

Day Workout Focus Detailed Protocol Target Intensity & Duration
Monday Lower Body Strength Squats (4x8), Romanian Deadlifts (3x10), Walking Lunges (3x12/leg), Calf Raises (3x15) RPE 7–8 | 45–50 mins
Tuesday Zone 2 Cardio Steady-state cycling, incline treadmill walk, or rowing machine Heart Rate Zone 2 (Conversational) | 40–45 mins
Wednesday Active Recovery Full-body dynamic stretching, foam rolling, low-intensity walk Low Intensity | 30–40 mins
Thursday Upper Body Strength Bench Press or Overhead Press (4x8), Barbell Rows (4x8), Incline Dumbbell Press (3x10), Lat Pulldowns (3x10) RPE 7–8 | 45–50 mins
Friday Zone 2 Cardio Steady-state outdoor jog, cycling, or elliptical session Heart Rate Zone 2 | 40–45 mins
Saturday Full-Body Conditioning Kettlebell Swings (4x15), Dumbbell Thrusters (3x10), Push-ups (3xMax), Pull-ups or Inverted Rows (3x8) Moderate-High Intensity | 35–40 mins
Sunday Rest & Mobility Gentle yoga flow, hip & shoulder mobility work, light walking Very Low / Rest | 20–30 mins
